Sy.No. 35/6 (Old Sy.No. 35/2) And 1 Acre 05 Guntas Of
Land In Sy.No. 35/9 (Old Sy.No. 35/3) At Mediagrahara
Village, Yelahanka Hobi, Bangalore North Taluk From
The Final Notification Bearing No. Udd/553/Mnx 2018
Dt. 30.10.2018 (Sl.No. 1272 And 1273) As Contained In
Annx-D Issued Buy R1.
 This Petition Coming On For Preliminary Hearing
This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The short grievance of the Petitioner - Developer is as against non-consideration of his Representations dated 03.05.2019, 02.08.2021 & 06.08.2021 (Annexures E, E1 & E2) wherein he has sought for apportionment of the compensation in respect of the land comprised in the acquisition Notifications.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner argues that in terms of Article 350 as M/S Pyramid Homes Pvt Ltd vs State Of Karnataka on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64023105/
2 interpreted by this Court in a catena of decisions there is a bounden duty cast upon on the Respondent - BDA to consider Representations in accordance with law and in a time bound way.
2. Learned AGA appears for the 1st Respondent.

entities.text: M/S Pyramid Homes Pvt Ltd vs State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Sr. Panel Counsel Sri K Krishna, appears for Respondent Nos. 2 to 4 initially opposed the Petition.

However, he now fairly submits that he would instruct his clients to look into the grievance of the Petitioner as has been aired in the subject Representations in accordance with law and in a time bound manner.

In view of the above, this writ petition is disposed off directing the 4th Respondent to consider the subject Representations so far as the request for apportionment of compensation is concerned within an outer limit of six months.
All contentions are kept open.
Since notice to 5th Respondent is dispensed with at this stage, he shall also be heard in the matter after issuance of notice to him.

It is open to the answering Respondent to solicit any information/documents from the side of the Petitioner for the due consideration of subject Representations; however, in the guise of such solicitation, no delay shall be brooked.
Now, no costs.
